Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precau- tions As for the bisphosphonates in general, p.1089. The most frequent adverse effects during risedronate thera- py are arthralgia and gastrointestinal disturbances. To minimise the risk of gastrointestinal effects precautions similar to those for alendronate should be observed (see p.1088), although UK licensed product informa- tion allows for the tablets to be taken other than on ris- ing (but not at bedtime or within 2 hours of food or drink). Hypocalcaemia should be corrected before be- ginning risedronate therapy. Effects on the eyes. For reports of ocular effects with the bis- phosphonates, including risedronate, see under Bisphospho- nates, p.1090. Effects on the gastrointestinal tract.
